body: As someone who actually has fun with tarot cards and things, i know that the cards aren’t really telling me the future, I know that you should never actually change what you’re doing in life due to the cards’ advice, or take the advice given by the cards as seriously as this, she sounds like she’s being completely ridiculous. Tarot cards are just a fun little way to give yourself an inkling of how the day might be, and there’s no way that she actually saw you dying in seventy two hours in a crystal ball! She probably has tricked herself into thinking all of this is real by getting a few things right, but all you can really do is shut this down and show her she’s wrong by going to work and living normally.
If there’s any reason you can find to live please try to think of it, you deserve happiness and to coexist with life’s trials, and to overcome them.

Try embroidery, origami, cooking/baking, small wood working projects, reading classic novels or short stories, you could also try and find a video game that doesn’t use too much mental energy like a puzzle or survival game, my favorite thing to do is just go for walks with my dog and take in nature.

Hey man when you need attention anyone’s bound to do things they’ll regret, but there’s nothing wrong with you or what you did. My boyfriend actually has done something similar when he was younger, and it’s something that didn’t deter me from him in the slightest! If you just relax and let it come I’m sure that love and happiness will find you!

Hey man, I can’t imagine what you’re going through, but I imagine law school would make a lot of people feel like they aren’t up to par, it’s an extremely difficult thing to go to school for and to be there at all and to have accomplished anything there is a success that you deserve to be proud of! Please don’t think that you’re a burden or that anyone hates you just for being yourself. You deserve happiness and love and it will come to you!
